SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DISTINCT SV01.CSTMR_ID , SV01.DEAL_STTMN_NO FROM KEPCON.KEPMPSV01 SV01, KEPCON.KEPMPSV02 SV02 WHERE SV01.CSTMR_ID = 'KRSUNG0254C001' AND SV01.DEAL_STTMN_NO = SV02.DEAL_STTMN_NO AND SV01.SND_CHK = 'N' AND SV02.SND_CHK = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT NVL(SO04.IF_ORDR_BIZNPLC_CD,'SDSM') AS PLANT , SV01.CSTMR_DEAL_STTMN_NO AS DLVY_NO , SO06.IF_ORDR_NO AS PO_NO , SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ AS PO_LNNO , DECODE(SV02.USE_CHK,'N','D','C') AS STATUS , SV01.DLVRY_DATE AS DLVY_DUE_DATE , SO06.SLS_UNTPRC AS PRCH_UNT_PR , SV02.DLVRY_QTY AS DLVY_DUE_QTY , SO06.SLS_UNTPRC*SV02.DLVRY_QTY AS DLVY_AMT , F_SPLIT(SO04.MNG_NO,'-',1) AS POR_NO , F_SPLIT(SO04.MNG_NO,'-',2) AS POR_LNNO , '' AS REMARK , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS IF_DATE , 'N' AS IF_FLAG FROM KEPCON.KEPMPSV01 SV01, KEPCON.KEPMPSV02 SV02, KEPCON.KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPCON.KEPMPSO04 SO04 WHERE SV01.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND SV01.DEAL_STTMN_NO = '$G_RS.DEAL_STTMN_NO$' AND SV01.SND_CHK = 'N' AND SV01.DEAL_STTMN_NO = SV02.DEAL_STTMN_NO AND SV02.SND_CHK = 'N' AND SV02.ORDR_NO = SO06.ORDR_NO AND SV02.ORDR_SEQ= SO06.ORDR_SEQ AND SO06.CSTMR_ID = SO04.CSTMR_ID AND SO06.ORDR_RE_NO = SO04.ORDR_RE_NO AND SO06.ORDR_RE_SEQ= SO04.ORDR_RE_SEQ
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPSV01 SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE DEAL_STTMN_NO = '$G_RS.DEAL_STTMN_NO$' AND SND_CHK = 'N'
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPSV01 SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE DEAL_STTMN_NO = '$G_RS.DEAL_STTMN_NO$' AND SND_CHK = 'N'
